name: Build, Test

on:

jobs:
  install:
    name: Install on Node.js v${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [24]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install node_modules
        uses: OffchainLabs/actions/node-modules/install@main
        with:
          cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-yarn-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}-monorepo

  lint:
    name: Lint on Node.js v${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [24]
    needs: install
    permissions:
      checks: write # https://github.com/mikepenz/action-junit-report/issues/23#issuecomment-1412597753
    env:
      TEST_PATH: /tmp/test-results
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install node_modules
        uses: OffchainLabs/actions/node-modules/install@main
        with:
          cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-yarn-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}-monorepo

      - name: Lint sdk
        run: |
          yarn gen:abi
          yarn build
          yarn lint --format junit -o $TEST_PATH/sdk-lint.xml

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lint-results-${{ github.run_id }}-node-v${{ matrix.node-version }}
          path: ${{ env.TEST_PATH }}

      - name: Publish Test Report
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v5
        if: always() # always run even if the previous step fails
        with:
          report_paths: '${{ env.TEST_PATH }}/sdk-lint.xml'
          fail_on_failure: false

        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install node_modules
        uses: OffchainLabs/actions/node-modules/install@main
        with:
          cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-yarn-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}-monorepo

      - run: yarn audit:ci

    name: Test (Unit) on Node.js v${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [24]
    needs: install
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install node_modules
        uses: OffchainLabs/actions/node-modules/install@main
        with:
          cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-yarn-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}-monorepo

      - name: Build
        run: |
          yarn gen:abi
          yarn build

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: CI=true yarn test:unit

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
